messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Incident detected — Sentry ingestion errors spiking for DSN `us-east-1` (provider: sentry-provider-v2). 72% 5xx in the last 3m. Link: https://internal.redwood.io/obs/sentry-ingest/overview

jamie: paging SRE — I'm on call. seeing customer reports about missing exceptions. can anyone confirm scope? :rotating_light:

alex: I can take a look. quick grep of the proxy logs shows a bunch of 502s from upstream:
```
2026-03-15T20:02:12Z proxy-1 error: upstream response 502 from sentry-provider-v2 (conn reset)
2026-03-15T20:02:14Z proxy-1 error: upstream response 502 from sentry-provider-v2 (timeout)
```
looks vendor-side but our proxy is returning 502 -> clients see failures.

priya: pinging vendor support and our oncall infra. @maria can you escalate to vendor SE and request event retention/backfill? this is causing missing exception signals which delays triage. :eyes:

maria: open ticket INC-4452 with vendor (https://vendor.support/cases/4452). summary added: "ingest 5xx spike US-EAST -> missing events / delayed alerts". Noted impacted: ~12 internal product teams + several external customers using live error webhooks. CS informed for top 5 accounts.

sentry-status-bot: Sentry provider status: Partial Degradation — Ingestion errors reported in us-east-1. Status page: https://status.vendor.com/incidents/ingest-us-east

alex: mitigation proposal: switch SDKs to fallback DSN that routes through our buffered collector (less direct to vendor) while vendor triages. patch command for k8s canary:
```
kubectl set env deployment/frontend SENTRY_DSN=https://fallback-collector.internal
kubectl rollout restart deployment/frontend -n prod --record
```
will patch canary pods 1/3 first.

jamie: applying canary now on frontend-1. monitoring error rate and user-facing logs. will roll forward if no regressions.

incident-bot: Automated action: emergency logging rule enabled — capture uncaught exceptions to persistent logs (log_errors:true) and increased local buffer retention to 6h.

leo: from runtime side — we've detected ~1.3k events dropped at ingest stage in last 30m based on sequence gaps. local SDK buffer still has ~900 events queued on disk per node. plan: leave buffered events local, attempt backfill when vendor confirms ingest healthy. command to snapshot buffer for backfill: `tar -czf /tmp/backfill-2026-03-15.tgz /var/sentry-buffer/*.json`

product-ops: customer impact note — external webhooks could have up to ~45m delay; alerts that rely on exceptions may have missed signals. CS notified enterprise accounts with suggested mitigation steps.

maria: vendor case update: vendor support acknowledged, assigned SE, requested logs and a replay plan. asking for retention of 1h beyond normal to allow backfill. vendor asked for a list of example event IDs — sending a sample payload now.

priya: if vendor cannot restore missing events we'll need to run a postmortem and consider a short-term alternate collector (minimal exception capture service) to avoid single-vendor dependency. creating follow-up ticket: INFRA-1793.

jamie: heading into evening handoff at 23:00 UTC. handoff summary for night oncall @leo: vendor partial degradation in US-EAST, fallback DSN in place, buffered events queued on nodes, vendor ticket INC-4452. primary contacts: @maria (support), @priya (sre lead), @alex (platform). escalate to on-call manager if missing events > 10k.

leo: ack — I'll take night. monitoring vendor status and backfill queue. will enable aggressive retries on the buffer sender if vendor confirms ingest is up.

sentry-status-bot: Update: vendor reports fix deployed to ingestion cluster in us-east; monitoring for 30m.

alex: doing a small canary to switch 1 pod back to primary DSN to validate ingest ack. then we'll roll traffic back in 2 waves. planning rollback in ~20m after canary looks good.

jamie: thanks all. next steps: 1) confirm vendor backfill capability and retention, 2) start backfill once vendor greenlight, 3) keep this channel open until backfill started + alerts quiet for 1h. :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll update customers post-backfill and own external comms. saving notes to INC-4452 and will attach vendor timeline.

priya: adding action items for postmortem and long-term mitigation (alternate collector, more durable local buffer, vendor SLAs).

leo: final note for night — watch for queue growth, if buffer > 2GB trigger paging and move to emergency broadcast.

jamie: closing the active paging window, leaving channel open for followups. thanks everyone for quick response.
